before.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at any nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
before.reason: The old array printer has no depth rejection, and the harness passes its parsed tree to a print function.

after.requirement: Print a parser-produced array at any nesting depth accepted by parsing without rejecting it solely for depth.
after.reason: The new array print guard uses the same pre-increment depth limit as both container parsers. The harness's print paths initialize depth to zero.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same harness prints a parser-returned tree. The new array guard cannot reject an array at a depth the parser accepts. Coverage is limited to the focused claim.
